## Problem and change

Describe the behavior before and after this change, and link the related issue.

## Verification

List commands run and their results. State skips, unavailable evidence and known
limitations. Separate measured values from proposed targets.

## Review notes

- Explain any public contract, dependency, data or license implications.
- Identify third-party material and its provenance when applicable.
- Keep raw restricted data, model weights, secrets and private prompts out.
- Update the release allowlist for reviewed new public files.
- Preserve the separation between model decisions and host execution/consent.
